reviews.title: Could be great!
reviews.text:
This app could’ve been great except for a couple of major flaws!

1. It takes forever for a file upload to queue meaning you have to leave your phone screen on for that duration, thus risking possible screen damage and unable to use your iPhone for anything else while waiting for the files to queue…that’s preposterous!!!

2. No matter how much you have already uploaded, a simple phone call will interrupt the upload meaning you have to start from scratch again…ridiculous!!!

3. There’s zero progress bar to indicate how far along the download has gone. With no visual cues, you have no way of checking if the download/ transfer is even in progress and the only message onscreen is a warning not to close the app and a cancel transfer button…not very well thought through!!!

If the speed of transfers is drastically improved, queuing taking less than a mi minute with progress bar, and transfers can continue in the background, then this can very easily be a five-star app better than anything out there.

reviews.title: No Notice of Annual Charge and No Refund
reviews.text:
I was charged for a 12-month subscription without clear notice or informed consent. At no point was it made clear that I was entering into an annual payment, nor did I receive advance notice that my payment method would be charged.

When I raised this with MEGA, the dispute was rejected and no refund was offered, despite the lack of clear disclosure and consent. Customer support focused on process rather than resolving the issue fairly.

Based on my experience, I would strongly advise others to be very cautious and ensure they fully understand any payment terms before using this service.
